review_candidates.title: Product Manager – Internal Products
review_candidates.description_excerpt: They work technically, but they often ship without a clear business problem, complete requirements, user journeys, or a definition of done. Key responsibilities -Product ownership and strategy Build and maintain an inventory of all internal products: purpose, users, owners, status, and known gaps. -Discovery and requirements Interview stakeholders and end users to understand real business processes and pain points before work starts. Requirements 8+ years in product management, product ownership
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: With a strong foundation in innovation and service excellence, 2P continues to provide end-to-end solutions through its specialized business units and trusted market expertise. They work technically, but they often ship without a clear business problem, complete requirements, user journeys, or a definition of done. -Discovery and requirements Interview stakeholders and end users to understand real business processes and pain points before work starts. Requirements 8+ years in product management, product ownership or business analysis, with at least 3–5 years owning a product end to end. Hands-on business analysis experience: requirements elicitation, process modelling (BPMN or similar), user stories and acceptance criteria.
